commands.command: python tools/corpus/cli.py been-tried "<one paragraph describing the idea>"
commands.name: oracle
commands.when: Before proposing or extending a direction: read the nearest retained negatives and say how the idea escapes them (MCP been_tried).

commands.name: screener
commands.when: Before any DQI claim: exit 1 means not viable under the Mazumder-Niroula soundness rules (MCP screen_dqi_candidate).

commands.command: python tools/corpus/cli.py baselines "<one line describing the idea>"
commands.name: baselines
commands.when: Before claiming an advantage: the classical algorithms the idea must be compared against (MCP classical_baselines).

commands.name: preflight
commands.when: Before every commit: exit 1 lists JSON that does not parse under research/hypotheses/, research/registry/, research/audits/ and research/classical_baselines/, plus theorems/, core/ and qsearch_cli/ modules the CLI refers to that are missing or not tracked by git, and research/audits/cli_manifest.json subcommands missing from the CLI registry's ORDER or listed there under another module.

commands.name: duplicates
commands.when: Before filing a negative: exit 2 means a retained or quarantined record is close (TF-IDF cosine 0.6 or above). A match is a record to read, not proof: extend it, say how the draft differs, or pass --allow ID for a sweep sibling you have read (MCP check_duplicate_negative).
